purpose: Eighteenth-pass official and first-party verification for six existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator pages, NHS/CQC records, Companies House records and official local-authority routes are promoted. Search snippets and directory-only claims are rejected.
method.current_status_policy: A current website, regulated registration, recruitment advert, company filing or planning route verifies identity or activity only; it does not prove executed lease terms, legal completion or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.

rows.address: 100 Central Road, Worcester Park, London, KT4 8HU
rows.resolved_fact: The primary auction record continues to identify the freehold mixed-use property at 100 Central Road, a ten-year Kimberley's Nail Design shop lease from 28 September 2023, occupation stated since 2013 and two flats held on long leases. A bounded current search again produced no public first-party booking, operator or official company route, so independent present-day trading remains unverified.
